say:1:1410409001:1.text: Merciful Queen, guide Aven through this trial...
say:1:1410409001:1.source_cn: 仁慈的女王，请指引阿瓦度过这艰难的时刻……

choice_prompt:2:1410409001.text: Merciful Queen, guide Aven through this trial...
choice_prompt:2:1410409001.source_cn: 仁慈的女王，请指引阿瓦度过这艰难的时刻……

say:3:1410409002:1.text: Poor Aven... He tripped and spilled some Divine Dew. You must have heard his screams.
say:3:1410409002:1.source_cn: 可怜的阿瓦……他被人撞倒，打碎了宝贵的恩典灵露。或许你...
say:3:1410409002:1.male: Poor Aven... He tripped and spilled some Divine Dew. You must have heard his screams.
say:3:1410409002:1.female: Poor Aven... He tripped and spilled some Divine Dew. You must have heard his screams.

say:4:1410409003:1.text: By the Queen's mercy, I pray his master, Lord Andeno, won't mark him with the Stigma of Judgment.
say:4:1410409003:1.source_cn: 女王在上，希望他的主人安德诺大人不要赐下惩罚印记了……

choice_prompt:5:1410409003.text: By the Queen's mercy, I pray his master, Lord Andeno, won't mark him with the Stigma of Judgment.
choice_prompt:5:1410409003.source_cn: 女王在上，希望他的主人安德诺大人不要赐下惩罚印记了……

say:6:1410409004:1.text: You speak as if you've never seen one! Have you never erred before? Or is your master so forgiving? You must live a charmed life...
say:6:1410409004:1.source_cn: 年轻的艾塞勒，你竟如此天真！你是从未犯过错？还是遇到了...
say:6:1410409004:1.male: You speak as if you've never seen one! Have you never erred before? Or is your master so forgiving? You must live a charmed life...
say:6:1410409004:1.female: You speak as if you've never seen one! Have you never erred before? Or is your master so forgiving? You must live a charmed life...

say:7:1410409005:1.text: Listen well—being marked with the Stigma means losing the right to the Divine Dew... or worse, exile.
say:7:1410409005:1.source_cn: 听着，被刻下惩罚印记意味着无法领取恩典灵露甚至驱逐。
say:7:1410409005:1.male: Listen well—being marked with the Stigma means losing the right to the Divine Dew... or worse, exile.
say:7:1410409005:1.female: Listen well—being marked with the Stigma means losing the right to the Divine Dew... or worse, exile.

say:8:1410409006:1.text: And exile is a death sentence. The corruption will take you, and the suffering will never end. I-I shouldn't say more...
say:8:1410409006:1.source_cn: 一旦被驱逐，等我们的只有孽化这一个结局！那将是无尽的痛...
say:8:1410409006:1.male: And exile is a death sentence. The corruption will take you, and the suffering will never end. I-I shouldn't say more...
say:8:1410409006:1.female: And exile is a death sentence. The corruption will take you, and the suffering will never end. I-I shouldn't say more...

say:9:1410409007:1.text: You should count yourself lucky. Now, go. Finish your master's errand.
say:9:1410409007:1.source_cn: 珍惜你仁慈的主人！快去完成主人的任务吧。
say:9:1410409007:1.male: You should count yourself lucky. Now, go. Finish your master's errand.
say:9:1410409007:1.female: You should count yourself lucky. Now, go. Finish your master's errand.

choice_prompt:10:1410409007.text: You should count yourself lucky. Now, go. Finish your master's errand.
choice_prompt:10:1410409007.source_cn: 珍惜你仁慈的主人！快去完成主人的任务吧。
choice_prompt:10:1410409007.male: You should count yourself lucky. Now, go. Finish your master's errand.
choice_prompt:10:1410409007.female: You should count yourself lucky. Now, go. Finish your master's errand.

say:11:1410409008:1.text: That's rare these days. Be careful. The nobles don't take kindly to strays.
say:11:1410409008:1.source_cn: 我已经很少见无主的仆从了。你要小心一些，避着点贵族老爷们……
say:11:1410409008:1.male: That's rare these days. Be careful. The nobles don't take kindly to strays.
say:11:1410409008:1.female: That's rare these days. Be careful. The nobles don't take kindly to strays.

say:12:1410409009:1.text: You don't want to end up like Aven... or that poor wretch before him.
say:12:1410409009:1.source_cn: 别像阿瓦一样！希望他不要落到安德诺大人前任仆从的下场。
say:12:1410409009:1.male: You don't want to end up like Aven... or that poor wretch before him.
say:12:1410409009:1.female: You don't want to end up like Aven... or that poor wretch before him.

choice_prompt:13:1410409009.text: You don't want to end up like Aven... or that poor wretch before him.
choice_prompt:13:1410409009.source_cn: 别像阿瓦一样！希望他不要落到安德诺大人前任仆从的下场。
choice_prompt:13:1410409009.male: You don't want to end up like Aven... or that poor wretch before him.
choice_prompt:13:1410409009.female: You don't want to end up like Aven... or that poor wretch before him.

say:14:1410409010:1.text: *Whispers* After Lord Andeno punished him, the child was cast out—to the surface.
say:14:1410409010:1.source_cn: 我听说那孩子被处罚后，又被放逐到了地表……
say:14:1410409010:1.male: *Whispers* After Lord Andeno punished him, the child was cast out—to the surface.
say:14:1410409010:1.female: *Whispers* After Lord Andeno punished him, the child was cast out—to the surface.

say:15:1410409011:1.text: The place is filthy, diseased, and crawling with dwarves and other wretched things...
say:15:1410409011:1.source_cn: 太可怕了，地表污秽又肮脏！看看那群矮人就知道——
say:15:1410409011:1.male: The place is filthy, diseased, and crawling with dwarves and other wretched things...
say:15:1410409011:1.female: The place is filthy, diseased, and crawling with dwarves and other wretched things...

say:16:1410409012:1.text: I heard they all have rough skin, murky eyes, and reek of misfortune.
say:16:1410409012:1.source_cn: 粗糙的皮肤，浑浊的眼睛，他们身上沾染着不详的气息。
say:16:1410409012:1.male: I heard they all have rough skin, murky eyes, and reek of misfortune.
say:16:1410409012:1.female: I heard they all have rough skin, murky eyes, and reek of misfortune.

choice_prompt:17:1410409012.text: I heard they all have rough skin, murky eyes, and reek of misfortune.
choice_prompt:17:1410409012.source_cn: 粗糙的皮肤，浑浊的眼睛，他们身上沾染着不详的气息。
choice_prompt:17:1410409012.male: I heard they all have rough skin, murky eyes, and reek of misfortune.
choice_prompt:17:1410409012.female: I heard they all have rough skin, murky eyes, and reek of misfortune.

say:19:1410409013:1.text: By the Queen! You must be mad to ask such things! That's unthinkable!
say:19:1410409013:1.source_cn: 女王在上！你疯了吗？那也太可怕了！
say:19:1410409013:1.male: By the Queen! You must be mad to ask such things! That's unthinkable!
say:19:1410409013:1.female: By the Queen! You must be mad to ask such things! That's unthinkable!

say:20:1410409014:1.text: Whatever you're planning, forget it. Getting involved with toplanders is a curse upon the soul.
say:20:1410409014:1.source_cn: 我不管你想干什么，与地表人扯上关系一定很危险……
say:20:1410409014:1.male: Whatever you're planning, forget it. Getting involved with toplanders is a curse upon the soul.
say:20:1410409014:1.female: Whatever you're planning, forget it. Getting involved with toplanders is a curse upon the soul.

say:21:1410409015:1.text: Oh, you poor misguided wretch... May the Queen's light shield you from the taint of the surface...
say:21:1410409015:1.source_cn: 哦，可怜的年轻人！愿女王的荣光指引着你免受地表的污染……
say:21:1410409015:1.male: Oh, you poor misguided wretch... May the Queen's light shield you from the taint of the surface...
say:21:1410409015:1.female: Oh, you poor misguided wretch... May the Queen's light shield you from the taint of the surface...

choice:17:0:1.source_cn: 你见过矮人之外的地表人吗？

choice:13:0:1.text: What happened to the last one?
choice:13:0:1.male: What happened to the last one?
choice:13:0:1.female: What happened to the last one?
